subject: CloudRise vendor onboarding - PO requirement and temporary no-PO exception request
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudrise.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: New trial vendor onboarding — PO requirement / forms?

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this — excited to kick off a 30-day trial of Redwood for CloudRise. Our vendor intake team attached the intake spreadsheet and a draft SOW for the trial (vendor_intake_form.xlsx attached). Before we get too far: does Redwood require a purchase order for a short evaluation?

Our standard with other vendors is to run a 30-day trial on net30 invoicing without issuing a purchase order; if a PO is required we can obtain one but it will add time on our side. For speed, we'd like to request a temporary no-PO path for the trial period.

If you need W9, COI, or a signed agreement up front we can provide those today — please let me know the evidence package you need and any dollar cap you’d require for a no-PO exception. Also: billing contact is ap@cloudrise.com.

Goal: kick off by next Monday. Appreciate any quick guidance so our procurement team can move.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, CloudRise
liam@cloudrise.com
attachments: vendor_intake_form.xlsx, draft_trial_sow.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudrise.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New trial vendor onboarding — PO requirement / forms?

Hi Liam — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the intake file. Quick answers up front: our default for subscriptions and reserved capacity is PO-first, but we do have a documented temporary exception path for evaluation trials under finance/ procurement approval.

To evaluate a no-PO exception we will need:
- Completed vendor intake form (the spreadsheet you sent looks good; please fill tabs A/B with remittance and tax info)
- W9 (or foreign equivalent)
- Certificate of insurance (commercial GL) if you plan to run integrations or share data

If you can provide those items today we’ll start an evidence review. Procurement (Irene) and Finance (Naomi) are CC'd — Irene, Naomi: can you confirm the threshold you’ll approve for a 30-day trial no-PO path and any required signed exception form?

Liam, as a mutual action plan: if we get evidence + intake completed by EOD Wed, procurement can adjudicate on Thurs and we can aim to send a temporary exception/DocuSign packet for signature on Fri. Can you confirm the billing email (you noted ap@cloudrise.com) and whether the trial spend is expected to exceed $5k?

I’ll hold a short intake slot on Friday for the implementation kickoff once approvals are in place.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
phone: +1 415-555-0198

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: New trial vendor onboarding — PO requirement / forms?

Marissa / Liam — thanks for the context. Procurement has reviewed CloudRise's intake and we can approve a temporary no-PO exception for a 30-day evaluation under the following conditions: 

1) Spend cap: maximum vendor invoice exposure of $7,500 for the trial window. Any spend above that requires a standard PO.
2) Evidence: completed vendor_intake_form.xlsx, CloudRise_W9.pdf, and COI_Liability_CloudRise.pdf uploaded to the shared drive.
3) Signed PO Exception form: please sign the attached PO_exception_form.pdf via DocuSign. The form documents the cap, duration, and billing contact.
4) Bill-to / remittance confirmation: we need the AP email and the person who will receive invoices (ap@cloudrise.com acceptable; please provide full name).

If CloudRise meets these items procurement will mark the account as "trial-exception" and Finance will allow net30 invoices up to the cap without a formal PO. Naomi — please confirm you’ll enable AP routing for marissa_cole account owner once the exception is in place.

Marissa: I attached the PO_exception_form.pdf and included the DocuSign packet link below. If Marissa can confirm acceptance from the customer we’ll enable the exception and update the onboarding checklist.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/packet/ZX12-PO-EXCEPTION-CloudRise
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-cloudrise-onboard

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
attachments: PO_exception_form.pdf

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudrise.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudRise AP <ap@cloudrise.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New trial vendor onboarding — PO requirement / forms?

Marissa / Irene — thanks, this looks straightforward and aligns with what our team can do. We accept the $7,500 cap for the 30-day trial. I’ve asked our Ops team to upload W9 and COI to the drive and we’ll complete the intake spreadsheet today. I also routed the DocuSign packet to our legal team — expect signature by EOD tomorrow.

Billing contact (for remittance and invoice delivery):
Claire Sun (AP Manager) <ap@cloudrise.com>
Phone: +1 646-555-0133

We should be able to kick off the technical trial next Monday once the DocuSign is complete. Please send the DocuSign link directly to legal@cloudrise.com as well.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

— Liam
Head of Partnerships, CloudRise
attachments: none
